name: Jurisdiction 2
definition: Contains information that identifies or is specific to a transaction jurisdiction.

DomesticIndicator.name: Domestic Indicator
DomesticIndicator.definition: When true, indicates the transaction is considered to be domestic.

DomesticQualification.name: Domestic Qualification
DomesticQualification.definition: Identifies the reason the transaction is considered to be domestic or non-domestic.
